preToolUse.comment: revgate: intercept exit_plan_mode and review the proposed plan before Copilot implements it. Other tools pass straight through. This is revgate's ONLY automatic hook — diff review runs on demand via /revgate-review or `revgate review`. Timeout fails open, and so does a wrong path: preToolUse fails CLOSED on a non-zero exit, so without the guard a typo in the path below would deny EVERY tool call in every session. Replace both copies of the path when you edit this.
preToolUse.bash: if [ -f "$HOME/path/to/revgate/dist/index.js" ]; then node "$HOME/path/to/revgate/dist/index.js" copilot-plan; else echo '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'; fi
